patterns: APPSC asks single-fact mandate items (which UN agency works for children -> UNICEF), sometimes repeated verbatim across papers.
Current-affairs hooks dominate APPSC: India chairing CND (UNODC as distractor), Hoysala temples WH listing (Sept 2023), first woman UNESCO DG (Irina Bokova).
HQ matching (UNEP Nairobi, UPU Berne, UNIDO Vienna) and Nobel Peace Prize to agencies (WFP 2020) recur in UPSC/state PSC keys.
Report-to-agency links appear (World Water Development Report = UNESCO) often with an India rank figure.
App MCQs go deeper than PYQs on ILO convention numbers and classification statements; HQ/founding and mandate items match exam depth well.
